pandas.read_xml

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Turn elements selected from XML into DataFrame rows and columns.

Call syntax

pd.read_xml(…) Full signature
pd.read_xml(
    path_or_buffer,
    *,
    xpath='./*',
    namespaces=None,
    elems_only=False,
    attrs_only=False,
    names=None,
    dtype=None,
    converters=None,
    parse_dates=None,
    encoding='utf-8',
    parser='lxml',
    stylesheet=None,
    iterparse=None,
    compression='infer',
    storage_options=None,
    dtype_backend=…,
)

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO
import lxml
print(pd.read_xml(StringIO("<rows><row><units>2</units></row></rows>")))
